result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position: subscription use extends to Affiliates and contractors acting on Customer’s behalf, termination is tied to Section 13.3’s uncured material-breach standard, paid-up and embedded licences remain perpetual and irrevocable, and transfer to a successor is permitted under Section 24. The revisions are confined to the licence-scope deficiencies and preserve the broader commercial structure. Drafting is professional, though Section 13.3’s phrase “except during a material uncured ... breach” is slightly awkward and could more directly address termination rather than only revocation or suspension.
